statement.en: For a cubic f(x)=ax³+bx²+cx+d,a≠0, (a)explain cases with2,1,0 critical numbers and give examples with graphs;(b)state the possible numbers of local extrema.

hint.ko: 정의와 주어진 조건을 식으로 옮겨 단계별로 계산한다.

ko: \(x^3-3x:\ c=-1,1;\quad x^3:\ c=0;\quad x^3+x:\ \text{no critical number}\)
en: \(f^{\prime}(x)=3ax^2+2bx+c,\quad\Delta=4(b^2-3ac)\)

If Δ>0,two distinct real roots each change derivative sign,giving one maximum and one minimum. If Δ=0,the single double root does not change sign,so there is no extremum. If Δ<0,there are no real roots or extrema.
\(x^3-3x:\ c=-1,1;\quad x^3:\ c=0;\quad x^3+x:\ \text{no critical number}\)

answer.en: (a)2,1,0 critical numbers are all possible.(b)There can be2 or0 local extrema.
